decisions.reason: A multi-model operator line with its own page is a core accessory to the garage door range and was only just launched.
The solid wood sectional door is a niche premium variant with only a website mention, but it rounds out the one-source residential range and costs little to keep.
The remote-controlled operator complements the garage door sales and is cheap to maintain, though it may later be folded into the operator line.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a standard part of a full industrial portfolio and were launched only a year ago.
The insulated glazed door meets energy-efficiency demand from commercial buildings and fits the firm's thermal solutions focus.
Having its own page signals that this glazed industrial door is a featured product the firm is actively promoting.
